questions.questionText: hour Additional Materials: Multiple Choice Answer Sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST Write in soft pencil. Do not use staples, paper clips, highlighters, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. There are thirty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any rough working should be done in this booklet.

questions.questionText: The five firm concentration ratio for an industry changes from 50% to 60%. Which statement about the industry is correct?

options.A: Each firm has become more efficient.
options.B: The industry has become more oligopolistic.
options.C: The industry has benefited from external economies of scale.
options.D: The industry now has fewer barriers to entry.

questions.questionText: The diagram shows the cost curves of a firm in a perfectly competitive market. MC Z ATC AVC X cost W V U O output Which segment of a curve shows the quantity that the firm would be willing to supply to the market in the short-run?

options.A: VX B UZ C VZ D WZ

questions.questionText: A perfectly competitive firm is currently producing at a level of output where its marginal cost is above both its average total cost and the market price. What will be the effect on price and output if the firm were to maximise its profit? effect on output effect on price

options.A: decrease increase

options.A: average fixed cost

questions.questionText: A good gives rise to external benefits and is produced under conditions of imperfect competition. Which statement must be true?

options.A: Benefits to consumers exceed the benefits to society.
options.B: Firms producing the good will make a loss.
options.C: Output of the good is below the socially optimum level.
options.D: Social costs of production exceed private costs.

options.A: the distribution of income

options.A: an appreciation of the foreign exchange rate
options.D: an increase in the rate of interest

What would result in an increase in the volume of bank deposits?

options.A: an increase in the public’s desire to hold cash
options.B: an increase in government expenditure financed by borrowing from the central bank
options.C: an increase in the proportion of their deposits that banks hold in cash
options.D: an open market sale of securities by the central bank

questions.questionText: In a banking system all banks maintain 10% of deposits as cash. Customers withdraw $20 000 in cash. Assuming no subsequent net change in notes and coins in circulation, by how much will the banks have to reduce their net loans?
Which change is most likely to increase both economic growth and economic development in the long-run?

options.A: a decrease in the savings ratio
options.B: an increase in investment in human capital
options.D: the greater use of compulsory overtime working of labour

questions.questionText: What is likely to result from the discovery of oil reserves in a developing economy?

options.A: a more equal distribution of income and wealth
options.B: an increase in the real exchange rate
options.C: an increase in the competitiveness of commercial agriculture
options.D: a reduction in the volume of imports of manufactured goods

questions.questionText: What will be most likely to decrease a country’s national output in the short run but to increase its potential for long-run growth?

options.A: a decrease in the level of import tariffs
options.B: a decrease in the rate of immigration
options.C: an increase in female participation in the labour force
options.D: an increase in the money supply

questions.questionText: The number of people employed in a country and the level of unemployment both decrease. What could explain this?

options.A: net inward immigration
options.B: an increase in the level of unemployment benefits
options.C: an increase in the age at which state pensions are payable
options.D: an increase in the number of students

questions.questionText: What would be an appropriate government action to reduce both a balance of payments current account surplus and the rate of inflation?

options.A: increase the money supply

questions.questionText: The government of Lesotho introduces a programme to promote exports and to encourage firms to grow by subsidising local entrepreneurs.
